## Activity

During June 2022, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 61 captures. This represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes. The recorded workload was assessed alongside the number of images available for grading and the subsequent findings.

## Image quality

Of the 61 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.9 per cent. These images could not be used to support a grading decision and are reported separately from the images that produced a grading outcome. The image-quality result should be monitored as part of routine site operations.

## Grading

Grading identified 15 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 23 days. This figure indicates the middle value for the time taken to complete grading during June 2022 and should be considered when reviewing service timeliness. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.
